eighth_channel_metadata: The data paper reports C4 whereas the Mendeley page reports C2; raw TXT files have no channel-name header. C2 is retained only as the deposited column label used by the source page, and this conflict is disclosed.
excluded_channels: packet counter, accelerometer, marker, packet-status, timestamp and all non-EEG auxiliary columns
binary_label: raw levels 0-1 = class 0; raw levels 2-3 = class 1
seed_aggregation: per-class median probability at window level; seeds are ensemble members, not statistical units
recording_aggregation: geometric mean of window probabilities, then argmax
statistical_unit: participant; cross-task directions are clustered within participant
noninferiority_margin_status: exploratory sensitivity parameter; not externally validated

cross_task.inner_split: two balanced recording-disjoint folds on all four source recordings
cross_task.gate_evidence_subset: source recordings 1, 2, 3 only, matching the three target recordings
cross_task.target_batch_setting: transductive; all three unlabeled target recordings are used for label-free diagnostics
cross_task.reason_for_target_natural_exclusion: Arithmetic natural and Stroop natural are exact same-participant duplicate files

arithmetic.inner_split: complete participant-level LOSO within each outer training set

stroop.inner_split: complete participant-level LOSO within each outer training set
stroop.reason_for_exclusion: Stroop high-level files for S14 and S15 are byte-identical and their provenance cannot be resolved

stacker.sample_weight: inverse number of windows in each recording

risk_gate.claim_scope: empirical exploratory soft fusion; no formal CVaR optimization, safety guarantee or no-regret guarantee

preprocessing.recording_notch: 50 Hz, Q=30, zero-phase second-order IIR on the complete recording
preprocessing.fft_length: next power of two for 2125 samples, therefore 4096

hard_exclusions.shared_cross_task_natural: all Arithmetic/Stroop natural pairs for S01-S15
hard_exclusions.old_results: all files under route_a/results, route_a/frozen and prior 53-57 outputs

claim_scope: The rerun is an exploratory methodological audit of leakage-resistant evaluation and conditional fusion; it does not establish general algorithmic superiority or formal risk control.
